name: spacescale
description: A live, collaborative environment where people and AI agents work together—built for education and adaptable to any team

scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run config:setup -- --env development && wrangler dev --config .generated/wrangler.development.jsonc --local
scripts.build: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env= --outdir dist/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.edge.json
scripts.test:edge: npm run build:web && npm run config:setup -- --env development && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && playwright test --config tests/playwright/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run docs:env-check && npm run observability:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run protocol:compat && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:edge && npm run security:scan
scripts.cf:types: npm run config:setup -- --env development && wrangler types apps/edge/worker-configuration.d.ts --config .generated/wrangler.development.jsonc --env-file .dev.vars.example --include-runtime false --env-interface CloudflareBindings
